text: Noah: Quick pass on the Dashboard 'Recent Activity' empty card. Current heading 'No recent activity' feels like a shrug. Also the tooltip on the + button says 'Create' — too vague. Priya: Agreed. Users need a hint about why it's empty and what to do next. Suggest heading: 'No activity yet' and subcopy: 'Run a request or pin a model to see activity here.' Diego: Love that. For the CTA tooltip, try 'Create a request' or 'Run a test request' depending on space. Tooltips should be 1 line + optional secondary: 'Start by running a sample call'. Noah: Also noticed the empty card uses a pale gray text that drops below 4.5:1 in dark theme. Can we pick a token that passes contrast? a11y-bot: Contrast note: current token is 3.3:1 in dark. Recommendation: use --text-muted-600 which tests 4.7:1 on dark backgrounds. Also make the icon accessible: include aria-hidden on decorative svg and move descriptive text into the DOM. Priya: Copy nit: avoid 'Run a request' for newcomers. Maybe: 'Try a sample request or pin a model to surface activity.' Keep verbs active. Diego: For the empty state CTA button, short label options: 'Run sample', 'Run sample request', 'Pin model'. Which is clearer? Noah: We should A/B 'Run sample' vs 'Run sample request' — analytics often show micro-differences matter. Add telemetry tag cta:dashboard_run_sample_vX. a11y-bot: Tooltip accessibility: ensure tooltip appears on keyboard focus and is reachable by screen readers. Use aria-describedby on the button and a visually hidden description for screen readers. Example snippet: ``` Run a sample API request to generate activity in this dashboard card. ``` Priya: Regarding microcopy in the helper line, propose: 'Try a sample API request to generate activity. Pin important models to keep them visible.' Short, declarative sentences. Diego: One more UX question: should we show an inline link to 'sample requests' doc? Might be helpful but we need to mark it with rel="noopener" and include a small external icon. Noah: Good idea. Link copy: 'Learn how to run a sample request' (accessible name). Ensure i18n key: dashboard.empty.learn_sample. a11y-bot: Focus management: when users trigger 'Run sample' and a modal opens, move focus to the modal heading and trap focus. On success, announce 'Sample request completed' and focus back to the card. Use live region for the announcement. Priya: Small localization note: avoid contractions and idioms. Use plain language per localization guidelines. Also keep strings under 60 chars where possible. Diego: I'll draft the new tokens: - dashboard.empty.title = 'No activity yet' - dashboard.empty.body = 'Try a sample API request to generate activity. Pin models to keep them visible.' - dashboard.empty.cta_run = 'Run sample request' - dashboard.empty.cta_pin = 'Pin model' - dashboard.empty.tooltip_run = 'Run a sample request' - dashboard.empty.learn = 'Learn how to run a sample request' Noah: Action items: Diego 1 update design mock + color tokens; Priya 1 prepare copy tokens + i18n ticket; Noah 1 add telemetry spec and PR checklist for a11y; a11y-bot 1 run contrast check when PR lands. Priya: I'll push copy PR today. Quick Q: do we prefer 'Run sample' or 'Run sample request' on mobile? Maybe shorter. Diego: If space is tight, truncate to 'Run sample' with accessible label 'Run sample request'. That keeps the visual short but screen readers get full context. Noah: Perfect. Thanks team — let's ship the copy + a11y fixes together. :rocket:
